ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle centered at A, C is on the left side of the circle, E is on the right side of the circle, and segment CE passes through the center A, therefore CE is a diameter. D is at the lower right of the circle, and the central angle ∠EAD formed by radii AE and AD is labeled 42°. Reasoning: Because ∠EAD is a central angle, the measure of its intercepted arc ED is equal to 42°. Also because CE is a diameter, the lower semicircular arc from C to E is 180°, and it is composed of arc CD and arc DE. Therefore m arc CD = 180° - 42° = 138°.
